t: The Mira Apt rear-fed exposed thermostatic mixer shower provides reliable temperature stability, ideal for busy family bathrooms. This chrome bar mixer features separate controls for precise temperature and flow adjustments, alongside a maximum temperature stop for increased safety, with an override function for a hotter shower. Cool Shield technology keeps the valve cool during operation, enhancing user safety. It is supplied with a single-spray pattern shower head, complete with rub-clean nozzles for straightforward limescale removal and easy maintenance, as well as a rail kit and hose.
